title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
abstract: arXiv:2611.22973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. translated_title: VITAL：用于验证制药药物研发与临床试验运营中智能体AI的框架
translated_abstract: 当前的保障方法无法确定证据是否足以在制药使用情境下对智能体人工智能进行验证、监控和治理。看似合理的输出可能掩盖检索、推理、编排或人工控制环节中的失败，尤其是在缺乏参考标准的情况下。我们通过现状分析、法规与标准映射、专家访谈以及多利益相关者的迭代完善，开发并实施了VITAL（基于预期用途、可追溯性、自主性和生命周期证据的验证）框架，这是一个面向临床开发中智能体的验证框架。VITAL在一个基于风险调整的框架内整合了使用情境、控制措施、行为验证和生命周期证据。我们将VITAL应用于流行病学与治疗格局分析、研究中心选择、入组拯救以及试验设计权衡支持等场景，以将自主性、可逆性、透明度和患者影响等维度落实到具体实践中。
tldr: 本文提出了VITAL验证框架，通过整合使用情境、控制措施、行为验证和生命周期证据，在风险调整框架内对制药药物研发和临床试验运营中的智能体AI进行验证、监控与治理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VITAL, a risk-adjusted validation framework integrating context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence to validate, monitor and govern agentic AI in pharmaceutical drug development and clinical trial operations.
